title: A Systematic Framework for Evaluating Topological Representations in Single-Cell Classification
summary: Recent advances in biomedicine generate high-dimensional single-cell data that describe cellular heterogeneity with unprecedented detail, but their geometric complexity and non-linear structure often limit the effectiveness of conventional statistical tools. Topological Data Analysis (TDA) provides a mathematical framework for characterizing the shape of data through persistent homology, which extracts structural features such as connected components and cycles across multiple scales.
